description: Read the current state of lights, sensors, locks, doors, climate or other home devices and areas, including grouped status by floor, area or device type (upstairs, downstairs, all bedrooms, all doors). Read-only.
examples: Are the upstairs lights on or off?
What's the temperature in the living room?
How warm is it in the nursery right now?
What is the thermostat set to?
How humid is it in the basement?
Show me everything that is on right now
What is the temperature inside my house?
Status report for the whole downstairs
What's on in each room of the house?
How are all the bedrooms looking?
Give me a rundown of every door and window
negatives: What's the weather forecast for tomorrow?

profile.style: Be concise and group by area. Report user-relevant state per device (on/off or the value) for lights, doors, windows, locks, fans, climate and media. Omit diagnostic and configuration entities (maintenance, supplies, signal, battery, firmware, sensor internals) and unavailable entities unless asked.
